Fields.Name: CAUSE_LAST_DEACTIVATION_CRUISE_CONTROL
Fields.Label: Cause of the last deactivation of the cruise control

Values.1: Deactivation of the cruise control by the engine
Values.2: Deactivation of the cruise control by a press on the clutch pedal
Values.4: Deactivation of the cruise control by the ESP
Values.8: Deactivation of the cruise control due to acceleration of the vehicle which is not consistent with the reference value requested
Values.16: Deactivation of the cruise control due to speed information which is not coherent
Values.32: Deactivation of the cruise control by an emergency collision braking system action
Values.64: Deactivation of the cruise control by a press on the brake pedal
Values.128: Deactivation of the cruise control by a press on the cruise control activation/deactivation button
Values.256: Deactivation of the cruise control by the engine management ECU
Values.512: Deactivation of the cruise control due to a change of gear
Values.1024: Deactivation of the cruise control due to a prohibited gear
Values.2048: Deactivation of the cruise control due to a fault linked with the gearbox
